dossier.public_summary: The dips alternate between very shallow and very deep and the measured depth changes by a factor of ~20 between sectors and even between individual transits in the same data product. This odd/even difference plus a missing transit and an extra-deep transit is strong evidence for two different eclipses seen at twice the reported period, and centroid imaging cannot show the signal is on the target star. A faint neighbour within one TESS pixel could easily produce this pattern, so the signal is best explained as a blended eclipsing binary, not a planet.

reasons.why: Odd and even dips differ by 1131 ppm with 13.04 sigma: one depth is 21x the other. This is the classic signature of a primary and secondary eclipse at twice the reported period (16.3 d), not a planet.

Depth is not constant: sector 14 depth 50±196 ppm vs sector 41 depth 1388±115 ppm. The verdict is changes_within_a_source (not a source calibration offset), and it persists within a single light-curve product, against a planet.

reasons.why: Individual transit depths are highly inconsistent with a single depth; a non-detection at epoch 1 and an overly deep event at epoch 2, followed by consistently deeper events in sectors 41 and 26, match a binary with few real eclipses driving the signal, not measurement scatter.
reasons.value: transits 23-25, p_consistent 1.4006e-33, chi2 219.9 dof 24, share_of_top_3 0.36, epoch 1 depth -110 ppm epoch 2 depth 1551 ppm

reasons.why: Location cannot be tied to the target. A star within 1 TESS pixel (18.2 arcsec) can produce the 1% dip with a 11% eclipse, so the variable-depth, odd-even, low-SNR inconsistency signal is best explained as a background/neighbour eclipsing binary blended in the aperture.

reasons.why: Star is spotted variable, but phase curve is small and shape is flat-bottomed (v_sigma -4.527). Spot-driven variability does not explain the factor-21 odd/even difference and order-of-magnitude depth changes with transit_depths justifying planet support, so binary/EB remains the positive explanation.
